scope: Old-development-map matched causal diagnostic. Separate from novel starts and formal standings. No new maps, maximum four post-intervention continuations.
qualification: After completing fit protocol: visible cells bit-identical; lower hidden micro MAE and macro eligible MAE versus both original and constant; normal public entry changes at least one real action on two distinct held-out terrains. No refit or map substitution on failure.
common_prefix: From true t=0 on old terrain, use incumbent against true full original (0.58s, T=1, natural entropy). Run candidate in shadow only on same candidate-observable history. Between t=24 and t=128 inclusive intervene at first actual difference in a friendly collector or planter command. No such interval means zero intervention recorded; stop paired suffix on that map and keep case.
treatment: Call original once on public pre-action state BEFORE seeing or executing either candidate arm. Use this same independently generated original move for both joint actions. Clone all mutable original tracker, previous observations, RNG and adaptive costs at fork. Restore identical captured state at the start of each branch. Both naturally continue from their own next map states, without scripted enemy moves. Apply student on root only, then identical incumbent continuation on both arms to official terminal. Verify repeated serialized digest of original snapshot and shared prefix/actions. Alternating sequential branch order across maps, as indicated, avoids fighting over one CPU, records all wall time and CPU/search depth.
outcome: Both scores, own-minus-opponent official terminal delta, deposits, ground rent, planting costs, time and depth per arm. Include both maps and missing/zero intervention. No promotion or causal population claim based on two arms. No recycling as a new-map win or as a ladder-time certificate.
